summary: Rivaline shows the marketing tools, ad library links and brand style of the site you are on. It reads that page in your browser and sends nothing to us.
reads: Script addresses, loaded file names, meta tags and the names of cookies on the page, never their values. Only after you click the icon.
Colors, fonts and the main button styles of that page.
A screenshot of the visible part of the tab, used only to cut out the logo and thrown away right after.
stores: Settings on your computer: default country and language.
Results stay in the side panel until you close it.
never: Read cookie values or what you type into forms
Send pages or results to any server
Keep a history of the sites you checked

perms.name: activeTab
perms.why: Read the current tab after you click the icon.

perms.name: scripting
perms.why: Run the reading function in that tab.

perms.name: sidePanel
perms.why: Show Rivaline next to the page.

perms.name: storage
perms.why: Save your settings on your computer.

notes: The ad library buttons open Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn in new tabs. Those sites have their own privacy policies.
Brand exports and the PDF are made in your browser.
